title: GreenJobs Platform Rebuild, Migration and Managed Hosting
subtitle: Proposal and services agreement for greenjobs.ie and greenjobs.co.uk. Prepared for Keith Molony, Managing Director, GreenJobs Ltd. Prepared by Debanjan Mazumdar, Founder, ProdCraft (debanjan@prodcraft.fyi).

kv: Keith Molony, Managing Director, GreenJobs Ltd (GreenJobs Limited, Ennis Digital Hub, Quin Road Business Park, Ennis, Co. Clare, V95 VW74), operator of greenjobs.ie and greenjobs.co.uk
All figures in euro (EUR), exclusive of VAT unless stated
Version 1.0. Becomes a binding services agreement when signed by both parties (Section 07).

blocks.p: This proposal contains all of the details and costs regarding the scope of work, timeline, investment and terms for the rebuild of the GreenJobs job boards, their migration off the current Strategies platform, and their ongoing managed hosting, as discussed between Keith Molony and Debanjan Mazumdar between 10 September and 29 September 2026.

blocks.h2: You have a 2008-era platform carrying a 2026 business.

blocks.p: Hi Keith,

Thank you for the feedback on the demo and for the notes from your site manager. I have boiled down our conversations since 10 September, your 28 September change document (114 individual requests) and your two emails of 29 September into one document, so that you and your Finance Manager can see the whole picture, every number, and exactly what you would be signing.
Where things stand today, from what I have measured on the live sites and what you have told me:

bullets: greenjobs.ie and greenjobs.co.uk run on a hosted job-board platform supplied by Strategies (strategies.co.uk). The platform is classic ASP (build tag 3.1.3), jQuery 1.11, Bootstrap 3, with Internet Explorer 8 compatibility shims still shipped to every visitor.

The Irish home page is 190 KB of HTML with about 1.03 MB of scripts, styles and key images and 1,090 links on one page. Job pages have Google JobPosting structured data switched off ("Invalid salary data"), so roles are invisible to Google for Jobs.

On the 22 September snapshot, salary was disclosed on 33% of Irish roles (29 of 88) and 57% of UK roles (56 of 98). Two agencies supply the large majority of listings, mostly through Broadbean, Idibu or LogicMelon multiposting.

Strategies publishes pricing "from £899 per month" (about €1,030) plus an 8 to 12 week delivery window for changes. Your actual invoice, tier, renewal date and notice period are not yet known to me and are listed as inputs in Section 04.

Since 22 September I have built and deployed a working front end for both editions at greenjobs-redesign.pages.dev: 195 pages on 165 live roles, every one of your change requests that is front-end work (100 of 114) implemented, and 3,047 automated checks passing at the last run on 30 September.

blocks.p: **What you asked for (29 September):** very little rebuild work is needed on top of what you have seen. What matters is hosting plus integrations, with a guarantee that matches what Strategies gives you today: uptime, backups, security, monitoring, and Broadbean, Idibu and LogicMelon continuing to post without interruption. You also want an easy way for your recruiters to post roles straight from their CRM, and for GreenJobs staff to post ads themselves.

This proposal is built around exactly that request. The rest of this document sets out the four problems the current setup is costing you, what you get in return, the scope and timeline phase by phase, the investment, and the terms.
Thanks,
Debanjan

blocks.h2: Four problems with the current setup.

blocks.h3: Problem 01. A recurring cost with no leverage

blocks.p: You pay a hosted platform vendor every month and are dependent on their roadmap and their 8 to 12 week delivery window for changes. Based on Strategies' public entry price of £899 per month (about €1,030) your recurring platform spend is estimated at about €1,030 per month, or roughly €12,400 per year, before any advertising. That estimate is derived from public pricing, not from your invoice, and is corrected in the final version once you share the Strategies figure.

blocks.h3: Problem 02. Roles are invisible where candidates search

blocks.p: JobPosting structured data is disabled on every job page, so none of your roles qualify for Google for Jobs. Salary is shown on only a third of Irish roles. Candidates who start on Google never see GreenJobs, and employers who pay for a Premium posting are not getting the reach the package promises.

blocks.h3: Problem 03. A slow, heavy site on a legacy stack

blocks.p: Every visitor downloads about a megabyte of assets and a 190 KB page built for browsers that no longer exist. Mobile visitors, who are the majority for job seekers, wait longest. The demo you reviewed serves the same content in 76.9 KB of CSS and 107.5 KB of JavaScript with zero third-party requests.

blocks.h3: Problem 04. Figures typed by hand, no dashboard

blocks.p: Counts on the current site (roles per county, sector and salary band) are typed in and go stale. There is no employer analytics and no KPI view for you. Your site manager's first question on 29 September was whether the stats update automatically. On the new platform every figure is computed from the job data on every post.

blocks.h3: Benefit 01. Both editions rebuilt, with every front-end request already done

blocks.p: greenjobs.ie (euro, en-IE) and greenjobs.co.uk (sterling, en-GB) as demonstrated: jobs board with filters, list, map and saved views, one page per role with JobPosting structured data, 14-sector taxonomy, salary insights and a data-generated salary guide, career quiz, employers page with a Premium and Membership comparison table and a live post-a-job preview that accepts the full job description, four SEO landing pages, a KPI dashboard, sitemap and 404. Salaries are never converted; sterling and euro are labelled with the bracketed equivalent at 1.17. 100 of your 114 requests are live; the remaining 11 need information or a decision from you (Section 04).

blocks.h3: Benefit 02. Your own platform, off Strategies, with the integrations kept

blocks.p: An admin posting console for GreenJobs staff, candidate accounts with stored CV, one-click apply, saved roles and email job alerts, multiposting endpoints for Broadbean, Idibu and LogicMelon verified by a daily test job, a recruiter posting integration so a role can be pushed from a recruiter's CRM to both boards in one step, a full export of jobs, employers and candidates from Strategies, and a 301 redirect map for every indexed URL. Stack: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, D1 and R2, transactional email via Postmark or Resend. Running cost of the infrastructure itself is under €50 per month and is included in the managed hosting fee.

blocks.h3: Benefit 03. Managed hosting with a written guarantee that matches Strategies point for point

blocks.p: 99.9% monthly uptime with service credits, daily off-site backups with a quarterly tested restore, Cloudflare firewall, DDoS protection and managed SSL, 24/7 monitoring with alerts to me, EU-region data preference, daily posting-route checks, a monthly report, and up to 4 hours of changes each month. The full guarantee table is in Section 05.

blocks.h3: Benefit 04. A recurring cost that drops to under half

blocks.p: From year two the total cost of both boards is €5,400 per year at the Care tier, against an estimated €12,400 today. Year one, including the one-off build and migration with the bundle credit, is €13,275, which is inside what you are estimated to spend today with no upgrade. Data is yours, in standard formats, with no lock-in after the first three months.

blocks.h2: What ProdCraft will deliver, phase by phase.

blocks.h3: Phase 1. Front-end rebuild on your domains (15 working days from signature)

bullets: Deploy the IE and UK editions demonstrated at greenjobs-redesign.pages.dev to greenjobs.ie and greenjobs.co.uk on Cloudflare Pages, reading live job data from the current Strategies platform until Phase 2 replaces it.

All 100 completed items from your 28 September change document, plus the two fixes from your site manager's questions (Premium and Membership only in the comparison table; full job description in the post-a-job preview).
The 11 open items applied the same working day you supply the input or decision (listed under Client inputs below).
Remove the noindex and robots block, submit sitemaps for both editions, and switch on JobPosting structured data for every live role.
Redirect map for the current URL structure to the new one, so no indexed page returns a 404 on launch day.
Handover: a written runbook, the test register (currently 3,047 automated checks) and the source repository.

blocks.h3: Phase 2. Platform migration off Strategies (6 to 8 weeks build, then a 30-day parallel run)

bullets: Admin posting console: GreenJobs staff create, edit, feature, close and repost roles for either edition with the same preview candidates see.
Candidate accounts: one registration, CV stored, one-click apply, saved roles and email job alerts tied to the account.
Multiposting endpoints for Broadbean, Idibu and LogicMelon, each verified by a test job posted through the route every day. Only the routes you confirm are in use are built and tested.
Recruiter posting integration: push a role from a recruiter's CRM (the CRM and its API access to be confirmed at kick-off) to both boards in one step.
Weekly newsletter send and job-alert emails through Postmark or Resend, using your sender domain.
Full data export from Strategies (jobs, employers, candidates, alert subscribers) and import into the new platform, with a reconciliation report.
301 redirect map for every indexed browse, job and employer URL, and analytics on the provider you choose.
30-day parallel run: the new platform runs alongside Strategies. DNS moves only after every posting route passes acceptance and you sign off in writing.

blocks.h3: Phase 3. Managed hosting and support (monthly, from Phase 1 go-live)

bullets: Care tier (€450 per month): hosting for greenjobs.ie and greenjobs.co.uk, SSL, daily backups, uptime and integration monitoring, security patches, up to 4 hours of changes per month, monthly report, and the service levels in Section 05.

Grow tier (€650 per month, optional): Care plus 10 hours per month for SEO and content (blog and salary insights), newsletter send, employer analytics, new features from a shared backlog and a quarterly review call.
Three-month minimum from the first monthly invoice, then rolling monthly with 30 days' written notice from either side. 10% discount for annual prepayment.

blocks.p: One weekly 30-minute call or written update, a shared change log, one business day response to any question, 4-hour response to a posting outage, and all infrastructure in accounts that GreenJobs owns so nothing is locked to ProdCraft.

Employer self-service purchasing and online card payment (Stripe billing) for job packages, since GreenJobs staff post the ads; the other eight sites in the GreenJobs network (ConservationJobs, EcologyJobs, EnvironmentalJobs, RenewableEnergyJobs, SolarJobs, WasteJobs, WaterJobs, WindJobs); writing career-advice articles or market reports beyond the salary guide; paid advertising; any fees charged by Broadbean, Idibu, LogicMelon or Strategies for onboarding, API access or data export; the paid Cloudflare Data Localisation add-on if a hard EU data-residency guarantee is required. Anything not listed in Phases 1 to 3 is a change request under clause 4 of the Terms.
